summary: PIM Manager now only touches what you define, and held policy changes come with a spreadsheet your change board can approve.

new.title: A spreadsheet for your change board
new.text: A large policy change held for approval now comes with an Excel file listing every setting's current and new value. Download it from Approvals with Download for change board.

fixes.title: Only what you define is changed
fixes.text: Policies are now changed only for groups you define or roles your assignments name. Policies on other groups and roles are left exactly as they are.

fixes.title: An empty environment changes nothing
fixes.text: When you have defined no admins, groups or assignments, the engine skips every step and writes nothing.
